import { MeshStandardNodeMaterial, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, texture } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, DirectionalLight, AmbientLight } = ctx.THREE;

  const cardGroup = new Group();

  // Create highly engineered metal card panel backing (PBR + machined look)
  const backGeom = new PlaneGeometry(2.4, 1.8);
  const backMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    metalness: 0.55,
    roughness: 0.5,
    transparent: false
  });

  // Vertical gradient shader using TSL nodes for the premium Nova Atelier feel
  const uvNode = uv();
  const baseColor = vec3(0.0431, 0.0431, 0.0627); // Surface/Ink dark mix (#0b0b10)
  const topColor = vec3(0.0863, 0.0863, 0.1137);  // Ink (#16161d)
  backMat.colorNode = mix(baseColor, topColor, uvNode.y);

  const backMesh = new Mesh(backGeom, backMat);
  cardGroup.add(backMesh);

  // Textured image cover for the high-end feature depiction
  const imagePlaneGeom = new PlaneGeometry(2.2, 1.15);
  const imageMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ 
    transparent: true, 
    opacity: 0.95,
    colorNode: baseColor
  });
  const imageMesh = new Mesh(imagePlaneGeom, imageMat);
  imageMesh.position.set(0, 0.2, 0.01);
  cardGroup.add(imageMesh);

  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      imageMat.colorNode = texture(tex);
      imageMat.needsUpdate = true;
    });
  }

  // Pure signal red (#ff2a38) highlight accent line representing the atelier heritage
  const accentGeom = new PlaneGeometry(2.4, 0.02);
  const accentMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ color: 0xff2a38 });
  const accentMesh = new Mesh(accentGeom, accentMat);
  accentMesh.position.set(0, -0.89, 0.02);
  cardGroup.add(accentMesh);

  // Local lights to cast brilliant metallic reflections on the anodized body
  const rimLight = new DirectionalLight(0xe8ecf2, 1.2);
  rimLight.position.set(1.5, 2.0, 1.5);
  cardGroup.add(rimLight);

  const fillLight = new AmbientLight(0x16161d, 0.6);
  cardGroup.add(fillLight);

  // Render Display Typeface using MSDF loader
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const textString = items.find(item => item.role === 'headline')?.text ?? 'Collection 3';

  const labelText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(textString, {
    fontSize: 39,
    color: '#e8ecf2',
    align: 'center'
  });
  
  // Clean offset placement & appropriate scale mapping
  labelText.position.set(0, -0.58, 0.03);
  labelText.scale.setScalar(0.0075);
  cardGroup.add(labelText);

  // Subtle breathing idle animation to make the card feel alive
  const idleTimeline = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1, yoyo: true });
  idleTimeline.to(cardGroup.rotation, {
    y: 0.04,
    x: 0.02,
    duration: 3.5,
    ease: 'power1.inOut'
  });

  // Strict local resource cleanup
  cardGroup.userData.cleanup = function() {
    idleTimeline.kill();
    backGeom.dispose();
    backMat.dispose();
    imagePlaneGeom.dispose();
    imageMat.dispose();
    accentGeom.dispose();
    accentMat.dispose();
  };

  return cardGroup;
}
